what_matters.head: September payrolls come out tonight at 20:30 SGT; analysts expect about 85,000 jobs and unemployment at 4.1%.
what_matters.detail: August added 162,000. The forecast is Bloomberg's survey, as reported by Yahoo Finance on Thursday.

what_matters.head: The dollar index rose 0.6%, 2.2× its usual day and the biggest markets move; the 10-year yield closed 6bp lower at 5.24% after climbing to about 5.3% earlier, a multi-decade high.
what_matters.detail: Reuters tied the dollar's rise to higher yields, weakness in French government bonds and energy prices. Stocks recovered from their lows as yields eased.

movers.why: Bernstein started coverage on Thursday with Outperform ratings on Lumentum, Coherent, Ciena and Arista, calling them structural winners in AI infrastructure; Coherent rose about 10% in the same session.
No news dated Thursday found. Investing.com's Thursday piece cites Mizuho's Outperform start the week before, plus its addition to the PHLX chip index and a $4B Japan expansion plan (undated there).

Reuters reported on Thursday, citing Anthropic's IPO prospectus, that Broadcom will lend Anthropic up to $42B in convertible notes to fund a five-year lease of TPU computing capacity. Coverage points to worry about Broadcom's financial exposure.
No new cause found for Thursday; it closed below its $185 IPO price. On 30 Sep its COO and CFO filed notices to sell about $84M of stock (a notice of intent, not a completed sale).
